primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 同一の個人系譜の用例として固定本文と前後を確認した。
primaryTextRead.text: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 同一の個人系譜の用例として固定本文と前後を確認した。
primaryTextRead.text: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
